title: Krul KB Index Contract
description: IPC message sent to kruld to trigger incremental knowledge-base updates. Any tool that changes source files — git hooks, CI pipelines, IDE plugins — should send this message to keep the KB current.

method.description: IPC method name. Must be the literal string 'index'.

project.description: Project name as registered with kruld (defaults to git root basename).

files.description: Source file paths that changed, relative to the project root. Omit or send an empty array for a full re-index. When present, the daemon may use this list for incremental indexing (Phase 7+).
